CONTACT FORM 7 FORMS list-forms first; avoid duplicate forms with the same title. The form tools support Contact Form 7 and require it to be active. Use create-cf7-form with title and template; use get-cf7-form before update-cf7-form. template is CF7 form markup and CF7 tags, not a PHP/JS generator. Use safe HTML and real CF7 controls. Do not build a fake HTML form with no handler, spam protection or delivery configuration. Honor the writer's control limits and reserved-name validation. Use names such as your-name rather than WordPress query vars. A required email tag can supply Reply-To; read get-cf7-form for recipient, subject and messages, and the current schema for attachment handling. Changing the form may affect every page that uses it. Place the form through Contact Form 7's registered Gutenberg block, or the returned shortcode in core/shortcode using valid saved markup. Follow block-discovery-contract for the block schema. The block as saved:
[contact-form-7 id="" title="
"]
Do not use a shortcode as a substitute for a normal layout block. Read back the form and preview the containing page. Preview proves rendering, not mail delivery; do not claim successful delivery without an authorized submission/delivery test. Delete only the requested form; check the pages that show it first.
